messages.subject: Project Onyx - completion arrangements (13 March)
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

We're set for completion this Friday 13 March. We'll circulate execution copies of the SSA, Investor Rights Agreement and new Articles via the signing platform today, with the board minutes and shareholder written resolutions. Please ensure all founder and director signatories are available between 10am and 12pm. The completion checklist tracks outstanding items - mainly share certificates and register updates, which we'll handle on the day.

James

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | www.whitfieldcarter.com
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
